about: Booking engines whose search page takes the dates in its URL. The reader opens a link to one of these hosts with the trip dates filled in. Add an engine only after a live check showed the trip dates and prices on the dated URL; params values use {check_in}, {check_out} and {guests}, with an optional strftime format such as {check_in:%d/%m/%Y}. guests_param null means the URL cannot set the guests, so the entry is used only when the trip has default_guests.

engines.name: Redforts
engines.note: Guests are chosen per room on the page; it lists rates for 2 adults.
